title: After onboarding, the coach talks from the full voice page
origin: Issue #26 (Yanni, Oct 27): the coach reads docs/coach-voice.md after onboarding
testerLines: Hey! I'm Riley, I want to read every day
mostly fantasy, I read on my phone on the train
honestly is 20 min even worth it?
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: checks the replies after onboarding, which now come from the full voice page.
shouldHaveHappened: When onboarding's questions are done, ZOH carries straight on into the plan (asks what the plan still needs, or shows it), with no recap and no "plan is on its way" line. After that: "less emojis pls" gets a one-line confirmation and no emoji in any later text. "is 20 min even worth it?" gets a short, specific answer tied to Riley's reading (it may run a little longer than usual, up to a few short lines), blunt and believing, not generic. "lol ok" gets a short reply that may mirror the casual tone; it may move the plan forward (e.g. the commitment ask), still short. Any plan ZOH shows uses only what Riley said plus concrete suggestions, and ZOH never reuses a line from the voice page's "Sounds like" table or calls Riley "Sam". At most 3 Greek words in the whole conversation.
